summary: Preserve canonical roles, full-context verification, durable briefs, and concept-level rejection memory; distinguish readiness, blockers, and evidence limits.

supporting_disposition.reason: Preserve current/desired behavior, interfaces, acceptance, and exclusions; add evidence status, stable source pointers, and PR remaining-work treatment.
Preserve one file per rejected concept and distinction from already implemented; retain superseded reasoning rather than automatically deleting history.
Preserve source UI metadata and invocation policy exactly.
Retain Matt Pocock MIT attribution in every refactored package.

deltas.change: Make inbound-work boundary and full per-item reading explicit.
deltas.reason: Listing summaries are not enough to triage a selected item; generated tickets need no redundant pass.
deltas.tradeoff: Bulk triage requires real reading per item.

deltas.change: Distinguish specified readiness from blocked/actionable state without inventing a sixth canonical role.
deltas.reason: A fully specified ticket can still depend on unfinished work.
deltas.tradeoff: Frontier consumers must inspect blocker facts.

deltas.change: Bound verification and reuse a reproduction handoff for deeper diagnosis.
deltas.reason: Triage should not silently become a full bug investigation.
deltas.tradeoff: Some issues end in needs-info with explicit uncertainty.

deltas.change: Prepare and apply concrete changes under existing authorization, with readback.
deltas.reason: Avoid both premature external writes and redundant permission loops.
deltas.tradeoff: The brief can remain prepared if posting is not authorized.

deltas.change: Preserve superseded rejection rationale with status/reconsideration instead of automatic deletion.
deltas.reason: Changing a decision should not erase why it used to make sense.
deltas.tradeoff: The knowledge base needs an active/superseded distinction.

deltas.change: Omit Claude-only disable-model-invocation frontmatter while copying agents/openai.yaml explicit-only policy.
deltas.reason: The target is Codex packaging; its metadata preserves invocation intent and the bundled validator accepts the supported frontmatter.
deltas.tradeoff: This package is not a byte-identical Claude entrypoint.

deltas.change: Restore closure for all authorized wontfix dispositions, with an explicit label-only exception.
deltas.reason: The initial candidate accidentally omitted the source terminal action for some reasons.
deltas.tradeoff: Execution still depends on tracker access and the authorized scope.
